name: OpenReplay Open-Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPLv3-licensed self-hosted edition for low-traffic session replay, developer tools, product analytics and co-browsing; recordings and storage run on your own infrastructure, without a hosted free-usage credit.
watch_out: Requires your own infrastructure (official starting guide suggests at least 2 vCPUs, 8 GB RAM and 50 GB disk), privacy consent and sensitive-data masking. AGPL source-sharing obligations may apply; paid Dedicated and Enterprise capabilities are separate.
